observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.dancers: a group of about 12 young female students
observation.formation_and_space: group arranged in a horizontal line facing forward across the stage, occasionally shifting or moving in unison

observation.footwork: stepping side to side, tapping heels, and light hopping steps on the beat
